records.speaker: Angelo Puccini
records.Japanese:
おい、おっさん！！
おっさんだよ、おっさん！！
records.current_English: Hey, old man! Old man! Yeah, you!

records.speaker: Angelo Puccini
records.Japanese:
そう。あんただ、あんた
港で噂を聞いてきたんだが
この船の提督さんだろ？
records.current_English:
Yeah, you. I heard about 
 you down at the port.
 You're the admiral, right?

records.speaker: Angelo Puccini
records.Japanese:
仕事が欲しくてよ
おっさんの船で働かしてくんねえか？
records.current_English:
I'm looking for work. Got a job
 for me on your ship, old man?

records.speaker: Gerhard Adernkatz
records.Japanese:
…何とも横柄な態度ですな
無視しておきますか
records.current_English:
What an insolent fellow... 
 Shall we ignore him?

records.speaker: Hodram Bergstrom
records.Japanese:
まあ、待て。俺は
FI・FA
この船の艦長をやっている
records.current_English:
Hold on. I'm this ship's captain.
 FI FA.

records.speaker: Hodram Bergstrom
records.Japanese:
船で働きたいと言ったな？
俺の艦隊に役立たずは必要ない
おまえに何ができるんだ？
records.current_English:
You want to work aboard my ship? 
 I've no use for dead weight
 in my fleet. What can you do?

records.speaker: Angelo Puccini
records.Japanese:
マンマミーヤ！？
そんなこと見りゃあ分かるだろ
オレのウリは強さと美しさだぜ！
records.current_English:
Mamma mia! Isn't it obvious? 
 I'm strong and I'm gorgeous!

records.speaker: Gerhard Adernkatz
records.Japanese:
呆れたやつだ。行きましょう
このような男は概して口先だけの
ものです
records.current_English:
Absurd. Let's go.
 Men like this are usually all talk.

records.speaker: Angelo Puccini
records.Japanese:
さっきから、うるせえんだよ
オレが話してんのはこっちの
暗いおっさんだ
あんたじゃねえ
records.current_English:
Will you shut up? I'm talking
 to the gloomy old man
 here, not you!

records.speaker: Gerhard Adernkatz
records.Japanese:
言わせておけば…！　貴様っ！
その強さとやら、私が試してやる
抜けっ！
records.current_English:
I've heard enough! Let's see how 
 strong you really are. Draw!

records.speaker: Angelo Puccini
records.Japanese:
そいつぁ、ちょうどいいや
来いよ！
records.current_English: Perfect. Come on!

records.speaker: Hodram Bergstrom
records.Japanese: やめないか！
records.current_English: Stop this!

records.speaker: Gerhard Adernkatz
records.Japanese:
ここはお任せください！
ここまで、提督を侮辱されては
引き下がれません！！
records.current_English:
Leave this to me! I can't let him
 insult you like that, Admiral!

records.speaker: Angelo Puccini
records.Japanese:
どうだい、どうだい！
オレ様は強えんだぜ！
records.current_English:
How do you like that? Told 
 you I was strong!

records.speaker: Gerhard Adernkatz
records.Japanese: むう…！
records.current_English: Grr...!

records.speaker: Hodram Bergstrom
records.Japanese:
ほう…。口先だけだと思ったが…
あのゲルハルトを追い込むとは…
records.current_English:
So he isn't all talk...
 He has Gerhard cornered.

records.speaker: Angelo Puccini
records.Japanese: いただきだぜ、とどめぇぇ！
records.current_English: I've got you now! You're finished!

records.speaker: Gerhard Adernkatz
records.Japanese: 甘いわっ！
records.current_English: Too easy!

records.speaker: Angelo Puccini
records.Japanese: くッ！！
records.current_English: Gah!

records.speaker: Hodram Bergstrom
records.Japanese:
…さすがゲルハルト
といったところか
だが…。あの男、面白い
records.current_English:
That's Gerhard for you. Still... 
 There's something about
 this fellow.

records.speaker: Angelo Puccini
records.Japanese:
おいおい、…ウソだろ
初めて負けちまったぜ
records.current_English: No way... I've never lost before.

records.speaker: Gerhard Adernkatz
records.Japanese:
世界は広い
貴様くらいの男は世の中に五万といる
…さて、行きましょうか。提督殿
records.current_English:
It's a big world. Plenty of men
 are as good as you.
 Shall we go, Admiral?

records.speaker: Hodram Bergstrom
records.Japanese: おい、貴様、船に来るか？
records.current_English: Want to join my ship?

records.speaker: Gerhard Adernkatz
records.Japanese: な、何ですと？
records.current_English: Wh-what?!

records.speaker: Hodram Bergstrom
records.Japanese:
まあ、確かに横柄だが、剣の素質は
なかなか。まだ未熟だが
おまえをここまで苦しめた男も
そうはいまい
records.current_English:
He's certainly rude, but he's
 got a gift with a sword. 
 He's still green, and
 look how hard he pushed you.

records.speaker: Gerhard Adernkatz
records.Japanese: …まあ、確かにそうですが
records.current_English: ...That is true.

records.speaker: Hodram Bergstrom
records.Japanese:
旅とは人を成長させるもの
こいつもきっと変わるだろう
どうだ？
records.current_English:
Travel makes people grow.
 I think he'll change, too. 
 What do you say?

records.speaker: Gerhard Adernkatz
records.Japanese:
まあ、FI殿が
そこまでおっしゃるのであれば…
records.current_English:
Well, if you feel
 that strongly, FI...

records.speaker: Angelo Puccini
records.Japanese:
お、おい。本当にいいのか？
オレはあんたたちに無礼なことを
やっちまったんじゃねえのかい？
records.current_English:
Y-you really mean it? After
 the way I talked to you?

records.speaker: Hodram Bergstrom
records.Japanese: ならば、その分は働いて返してもらおう
records.current_English: Then make up for it with good work.

records.speaker: Angelo Puccini
records.Japanese:
…へっ。じゃあ、そうさせてもらうぜ
すまねえな。オレはアンジェロ
アンジェロ・プッチーニだ
records.current_English:
Heh... All right, I'll take you up 
 on that. Thanks. I'm Angelo. 
 Angelo Puccini.

records.speaker: Angelo Puccini
records.Japanese:
ところで提督さんよ。交易で儲けたい
なら、こんな地中海なんかで
ちまちまやってちゃダメだぜ
records.current_English:
By the way, Admiral. If you want to
 make money trading, quit scratching
 around in the Mediterranean.

records.speaker: Hodram Bergstrom
records.Japanese: なぜだ？
records.current_English: Why?

records.speaker: Julio Erneco
records.Japanese:
ほう…！
おぬし、なかなか分かっておるな！
records.current_English: Oh! You understand trade well!

records.speaker: Angelo Puccini
records.Japanese:
確かにここいらは航路も発達してて
一見おいしいが、すでに大きな勢力が
開発しつくしてて、うまみが少ねえ
records.current_English:
Sure, the trade routes here
 are well established, so it looks
 promising. But the big powers
 have already developed everything. 
 There isn't much profit left.

records.speaker: Hodram Bergstrom
records.Japanese: …ふむ

records.speaker: Angelo Puccini
records.Japanese:
やっぱ、外に行かねえとな
アフリカや新大陸は、まだまだ発展する
余地がある。ちょっとの投資で
大きな見返りがあるんだ
records.current_English:
You've got to head farther out.
 Africa and the New World still 
 have plenty of room to grow.
 
 A little investment can bring
 a big return.

records.speaker: Angelo Puccini
records.Japanese:
しかも、売ってる交易品が珍しいから
ヨーロッパと往復するだけで
簡単に大金が転がり込んでくる
はずさ
records.current_English:
And they've got unusual goods. Just
 hauling them back and forth
 to Europe should bring 
 in a fortune.

records.speaker: Hodram Bergstrom
records.Japanese:
交易にも造詣が深いとはな
…見かけによらんものだ
records.current_English:
You know your trade, too.
 I wouldn't have guessed.

records.speaker: Angelo Puccini
records.Japanese:
よせよ
船乗りたちの受け売りさ
records.current_English:
Aw, I just picked it up
 from sailors.

records.speaker: Julio Erneco
records.Japanese:
いやいや
確かにこの男の言う通りじゃ
records.current_English: No, no. The man is quite right.

records.speaker: Julio Erneco
records.Japanese:
せっかく船を買って積荷倉庫が
増えても、なかなかシェアを取れぬ
ヨーロッパでは、交易品を一度に
たくさん商うことができんからのう
records.current_English:
More cargo holds won't help much 
 in Europe. It's hard to get
 market share there, and you can't
 trade in bulk without it.

records.speaker: Hodram Bergstrom
records.Japanese:
早速の助言、感謝する
外洋に出てみることにしよう
records.current_English:
Thanks for the tip. Let's see
 what's out on the open sea.
